claims.claim: A ten-dimensional self-dual five-form admits 81 functionally independent Lorentz invariants.
claims.prior: Hutomo, Lechner and Sorokin, JHEP 02 (2026) 147 [2509.14351]; Cederwall et al., J.Phys.A 59 (2026) 065203 [2509.14350].
claims.here: A machine-checkable lower bound of 81 matching the published count, from an exact modular Jacobian over a 15-cell sample-by-prime matrix.
claims.wording: The count is attributed to the sources. This paper supplies a certificate for it, and says so.

claims.claim: 126 - dim so(1,9) = 81 bounds the generic functional rank above.
claims.here: Cited, not reproved. It is the upper half of the rank statement and no computation here supplies it.

claims.claim: Enumerate contraction graphs, evaluate on generated tensor data, find linear relations to expose functional dependencies.
claims.prior: Elamaran, Ferko and Scarlett, Phys.Rev.D 114 (2026) 026016 [2512.23750], for a 3-form in six dimensions.
claims.here: An exact and certified realization of that workflow for the ten-dimensional self-dual five-form: integral coordinate basis, modular arithmetic throughout, holdout primes, and a characteristic-zero lower bound rather than a numerical rank.
claims.wording: MANDATORY. The general workflow is prior art and must be credited as such. The manuscript may claim only the exact and certified realization, never the approach.

claims.claim: The tensor and spinor descriptions of the self-dual five-form correspond.
claims.prior: Standard Clifford algebra; the correspondence is classical and is used in [2509.14350].
claims.here: An explicit executable map with an exact left inverse, verified at two primes.
claims.wording: The correspondence is classical. The executable exact map is the contribution.

claims.claim: An exact equivariant bridge Phi: Lambda^5_+ V -> Sym^2_{gamma-tr} S_+ with forward rank 126, kernel exactly the anti-self-dual 126, image exactly the gamma-traceless 126, and a left inverse composing to the self-dual projector.
claims.prior: No source found giving the map with certificates. Searched: both core papers and their 98 combined references, all 18 citing papers, and the spinor-conventions literature.
claims.here: Span equalities rather than dimension coincidences; equivariance under GL(5) with the det character and under Clifford reflections, which generate the full group by Cartan-Dieudonne.
claims.wording: May be described as, to our knowledge, not previously given with certificates. Not 'first'.

claims.claim: The oscillator frame's real form is split (5,5), not Euclidean SO(10); (5,5) and (1,9) are inequivalent real forms, congruent over C and over F_p.
claims.prior: Real forms of Spin(10,C) are standard. The specific correction and its consequence for this construction are not in the literature because the construction is not either.
claims.here: The metric is extracted from the anticommutators rather than assumed, and the frame transition is constructed and checked.
claims.wording: A correction to this project's own earlier record. The manuscript states the mathematics, not the history, and must not claim a real orthogonal transformation between inequivalent signatures.

claims.claim: Degree-8 tensor and spinor spans are equal, and the structured tensor-word family is what supplies the missing direction.
claims.here: Rank 7 on both sides, union rank 7, containment both ways, two fitting and two holdout primes, and a family ablation showing the port-graph family alone reaches only 6.
claims.wording: May be stated as certified. The ablation is reported because it is the informative part.

claims.claim: Degree-10 tensor and spinor spans are equal.
claims.here: Rank 14 on both sides on a common sample, holdout validated. Both spans equal A10, whose dimension 14 is structural.
claims.wording: May be stated as certified. Does not depend on exhausting either grammar; see docs/DEGREE10_NO_STOP_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM.md.

claims.claim: An explicit 81x81 minor of the integral Jacobian has nonzero determinant, giving rank_Q >= 81 unconditionally.
claims.prior: None found. The count 81 is prior; a certificate for it is not.
claims.here: Two independent determinant routines agreeing, over a matrix of sample points and primes, with the integer-lift argument stated.
claims.wording: 'Certified', not 'proved'. The matching upper bound is analytic and belongs to N-02.

claims.claim: The complete degree-10 atlas and its incidence table.
claims.prior: Twelve degree-10 candidate structures appear in [2509.14350], as expressions rather than a basis, with relations undetermined.
claims.here: Dimensions and containments for A10, B10, G10, P10, D10, with the correction that the published span is not a product complement.
claims.wording: 'Complete' is permitted for the atlas only in the sense certified, and B10 carries 'at the tested primes'.

claims.claim: dim_Q A10 = 14, dim_Q D10 = 11, dim_Q Q10 = 3, over the rationals.
claims.prior: None. Earlier statements of these numbers, including this project's own, were modular.
claims.here: A10's upper bound is structural; D10 is an exact rational fixed-point closure, agreeing with the modular record and with the same free columns.
claims.wording: May be stated as exact over Q. The seed-closure scope caveat travels with it.

claims.claim: The pure-N^(4125) compact basis for Q10.
claims.here: Constructed with certificates; described as preferred ambiguity-minimal, since PO-11 leaves one member source-reading-dependent.

claims.claim: Formula-independent reverse recovery of the degree-10 quotient.
claims.prior: Reproduces the published Level-B span from an independent search.
claims.here: Recovery, on fit and holdout primes.

claims.claim: A reproducible computational proof architecture: frozen executions, immutable per-cell artifacts, read-only aggregation with adversarial tests, clean-clone reproduction.
claims.prior: No comparable apparatus found in this literature. Finite-field linear algebra itself is standard and is cited.
claims.here: 32 aggregator tests, each breaking one thing and asserting the named refusal; source-critical hashing; provenance binding.
claims.wording: May be described as, to our knowledge, going beyond the reproducibility of the source literature. Not 'first'.

claims.claim: A degree-10 stress-flow obstruction with physical consequences.
claims.prior: Qualitative non-universality in D=10 is in [2509.14351].
claims.here: The exact codimension is established; the physical reading is not, because PO-07 is open.
claims.wording: REMOVED as a physical claim. Appears as a mathematical application with the physical reading explicitly withheld.

first.rule: Not licensed anywhere. The priority ledger supports 'to our knowledge, not previously given' at most. Do not use.

complete.rule: Permitted only for the degree-10 atlas in the certified sense, and never for enumeration (PO-12) or for the invariant ring.

exact.rule: Permitted for arithmetic that is exact -- modular or rational -- never for a claim whose bound is one-sided.

unique.rule: Not licensed. No uniqueness is established for any basis or representative.

canonical.rule: Not licensed. Forbidden for Q10 representatives; see docs/Q10_CANONICALITY_SCOPE.md.

minimal.rule: Permitted only as 'minimum cardinality in any basis' (PO-08 cardinality half) or 'preferred ambiguity-minimal'. Never bare.

exhaustive.rule: Not licensed at degree 10 (PO-12) or for any grammar. Degrees 4, 6, 8 reached candidate_exhaustion and that specific word may be quoted as a terminal state.

previously unknown.rule: Not licensed. Use 'we have not found it in the literature searched', with the search scope stated.

syzygy.rule: Not licensed for I12_61/I12_62 (PO-03); only a Jacobian dependence is established.
